## Type

- [ ] `feat` — new user-visible capability
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix (please link the issue)
- [ ] `refactor` — no behavior change
- [ ] `test` — tests only
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `build` / `ci` / `chore`

## Checklist

- [ ] `make test` passes locally (2,100+ checks)
- [ ] Behavior changes are covered by new or updated tests in `tests/test_main.cpp`
- [ ] Hand-written containers in `basic_structures/` were **not** replaced with `std::` equivalents
- [ ] README / `docs/IMPROVEMENTS.md` updated if user-visible behavior changed
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, ...)
